data.test_split_policy: Do not read, train on, tune on, or evaluate on the official test split during preparation or model selection. A future one-time comparison is exploratory because upstream checkpoint selection used that split.

common_training.seed_policy: Reset Python, NumPy, torch CPU/CUDA, sampler generator, and augmentation RNG to 20261026 for each arm; use identical initial classifier-head tensors. Set cuDNN deterministic=true and benchmark=false. Record that bitwise determinism is not guaranteed across library/GPU changes.
common_training.precision: fp16 autocast with GradScaler; fp32 parameters
common_training.scheduler: CosineAnnealingLR stepped once per epoch; T_max=12; eta_min=1e-6
common_training.sampler_draws_per_epoch: number of rows in the training partition, sampled with replacement

A_standard_class_balanced.sample_weight_per_image: 1 / n_y, where n_y is the number of training-partition images in diagnosis y

B_capped_fitzpatrick_reweight.normalization: Divide each diagnosis's raw weights by their sum within that diagnosis so each diagnosis has total sampler mass 1, matching Arm A.
B_capped_fitzpatrick_reweight.counts_scope: Compute n_y, n_(y,g), and unique-subject eligibility from the training partition only; never use validation or test counts.

validation.tie_breaker: lower validation cross-entropy loss when macro F1 differs by less than 0.002
metrics: per-class precision, recall, F1, and support
Fitzpatrick-group accuracy and macro F1 with support
Pigmentary Disorders FST 3 and FST 5 recall and their difference

test.future_use: At most one exploratory comparison after both arms are frozen; no confirmatory claim due prior upstream use for checkpoint selection and hypothesis discovery.

preparation_benchmark.asset_reachability_from_machine: Verified: completed HTTPS download from the exact official SwinTransformer release URL in timm's pretrained configuration.
